name: Star Fox Adventures
description: Star Fox Adventures for PS Vita: a native port
long_description: A native PS Vita port of Star Fox Adventures (GameCube), built on the Star Fox Adventures decompilation and its PC port branch (Cassieandstuff/SFA-Decomp@pc-port-continued), with a graphics backend written for the Vita's GPU.
requirements:
- A PS Vita or PS TV on custom firmware (HENkaku / Enso).
- libshacccg.suprx at ur0:data/libshacccg.suprx (the shader compiler that many Vita homebrew ports also need). Without it the game still runs, but shaders that are not included in the package draw through a slower fallback.
- A disc image of your own copy of Star Fox Adventures for GameCube, USA, Rev 1 (game id GSAE01, disc version 1), as a full, uncompressed .iso (about 1.4 GB).
